## Converting the Date Column to Datetime
```{python}
data["date_local"]=pd.to_datetime(data["date_local"])
```
## Checking for Missing Values
```{python}
data.isna().sum()
```
## Creating a Missing Value Mask
```{python}
mask=data.isna()
mask=mask.any(axis=1)
```
## Extracting Rows with Missing Values
```{python}
nulls=data[mask]
nulls
```
## Checking for Duplicate Records
```{python}
data.duplicated().sum()
```
## Visualizing the AQI Log Distribution
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
sns.histplot(data["aqi_log"], color="skyblue", kde=True)
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
## Detecting Outliers Using a Boxplot
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
sns.boxplot(data=data, x="aqi_log", color="skyblue")
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
## Calculating Mean and Standard Deviation
```{python}
mean=data["aqi_log"].mean()
std=data["aqi_log"].std()
upper_limit=mean + 1* std
lower_limit= mean - 1* std
```
## Finding Values Within 1 Standard Deviation
```{python}
data["aqi_log"].between(lower_limit,upper_limit).mean()*100
```
## Finding Values Within 2 Standard Deviations
```{python}
upper_limit=mean + 2* std
lower_limit= mean - 2* std
data["aqi_log"].between(lower_limit,upper_limit).mean()* 100
```
## Finding Values Within 3 Standard Deviations
```{python}
upper_limit=mean + 3* std
lower_limit= mean -3* std
data["aqi_log"].between(lower_limit,upper_limit).mean()* 100
```
## Calculating Z-Scores
```{python}
from scipy import stats
data["Z_score"]=stats.zscore(data["aqi_log"])
data.head(10)
```
## Detecting Outliers Using Z-Score Analysis
```{python}
data[(data["Z_score"]>3) | (data["Z_score"]<-3)]
```
